newsitem.title: LEBANON: Egypt's Mubarak says war is "out of fashion".
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak says war is "out of fashion".

text.p: Egypt's President Hosni Mubarak, in remarks published on Wednesday, said war had gone "out of fashion" and an outbreak of war in the Middle East was almost impossible.

"The possibilities for such a war, contrary to what is being said, are very remote if not impossible. Everyone loses in such a war. Israel loses, Syria loses and the Arabs lose," Mubarak told the Beirut newspaper An-Nahar in an interview.
The alternative to peace in the Middle East would be "horrible" terrorism, he warned.

"War is out of fashion... war is the easiest thing. It has a known goal and a limited platform. But if the peace process collapses, it is much worse than war. Let me stress that terrorism and violence are more dangerous and horrible than war," Mubarak said.
Peace talks between Israel and Syria, which were called off last year, had been stumbling since 1991 over an Israeli pullout from the occupied Golan Heights and a south Lebanon occupation zone.
